why: Alifiya 2026-10-26: replace the drawn beige infographics on every engine post with a painted labelled illustration (IMAGE1) and a natural photo (IMAGE2, the new cover). See rules/images.md.

illustration.subject: a single human sperm cell, greatly enlarged, shown from the side with a cut-away of the head
illustration.action: the head opened to show the tightly packed DNA in the nucleus and the cap-like acrosome
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of a sperm cell, the cell that sperm freezing protects: head, acrosome, DNA, midpiece and tail

photo.scene: the gloved hands of a lab specialist lowering a canister of frozen samples into an open liquid-nitrogen storage tank, wisps of cold vapour rising, clean bright lab, side light
photo.alt: Sperm freezing storage: a lab specialist lowers frozen samples into a liquid nitrogen tank

illustration.subject: the donor egg IVF process drawn as one flowing scene from left to right
illustration.action: a donor's ovary with a mature egg, the egg meeting a sperm in the lab, a small embryo, and the embryo being placed in the recipient's uterus shown in frontal cross-section
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of the donor eggs procedure: donor egg, fertilization, embryo and transfer into your uterus

photo.scene: a woman in her mid-40s and her partner sitting together at a light wood desk across from a doctor, the doctor seen from behind and out of focus, the woman smiling gently, bright calm consultation room
photo.alt: A couple in their 40s talking with a fertility doctor about the donor eggs procedure

illustration.subject: a day-5 human blastocyst, greatly enlarged
illustration.action: held by a holding pipette on the left while a thin biopsy pipette on the right gently draws a few outer cells; the inner cell mass on the opposite side is untouched
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of PGT-A testing: a few trophectoderm cells taken from a blastocyst with a biopsy pipette

photo.scene: an embryologist in a mask, cap and gloves working at an inverted microscope in a modern IVF lab, seen from the side, soft daylight, monitors blank
photo.alt: An embryologist at a microscope in an IVF lab, where the PGT-A testing biopsy is done

illustration.subject: frontal cross-section of the uterus, both fallopian tubes and both ovaries during a tube test
illustration.action: a thin soft catheter in the cervix fills the uterine cavity with contrast fluid, which flows along both tubes and spills out of their open ends
labels: Fluid spills from an open tube
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of an HSG test: contrast fluid fills the uterus and flows out through open fallopian tubes

photo.scene: a calm, bright imaging room with an exam table covered by a fresh white sheet, an ultrasound machine with a blank screen, a folded blanket, soft window light, no people
photo.alt: A bright, calm exam room where an HSG test or HyCoSy is done

illustration.subject: a mature human egg (oocyte) greatly enlarged in cross-section
illustration.action: showing the chromosomes lined up on the spindle, the clear zona pellucida, a small first polar body and a ring of surrounding cumulus cells
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of an egg with its chromosomes and spindle, why egg quality matters for pregnancy at 45

photo.scene: a woman in her mid-40s walking on a tree-lined path in warm autumn light, relaxed and hopeful, holding a coffee cup, seen from the side
photo.alt: A woman in her mid-40s on an autumn walk, thinking about pregnancy at 45

illustration.subject: a human ovary in cross-section with very few follicles
illustration.action: a few small resting follicles scattered in the outer layer and one follicle that has woken up and started to grow, its egg visible inside
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of an ovary in premature ovarian insufficiency: few resting follicles, one starting to grow

photo.scene: a woman in her early 30s sitting on a sofa by a big window at home, reading notes on a tablet with a blank screen, calm and focused, soft daylight, plants
photo.alt: A woman in her 30s reading about POI (premature ovarian insufficiency) at home

illustration.subject: frontal view of the female reproductive organs at ovulation
illustration.action: an ovary releasing an egg into the fallopian tube, sperm swimming up through the uterus, and one sperm meeting the egg inside the tube
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of trying to conceive fertility basics: ovulation, sperm meeting the egg, and the uterus

photo.scene: a couple in their early 30s in a sunny kitchen in the morning, laughing together over coffee, natural and relaxed, plants and light wood
photo.alt: A couple in their 30s at breakfast while they are trying to conceive

illustration.subject: a human ovary in cross-section, like a textbook plate
illustration.action: a fine needle delivers platelet-rich plasma into the ovarian tissue; tiny soft particles of growth factors spread among small resting follicles, and a few nearby follicles have started to grow
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of PRP ovaries treatment: a fine needle delivers growth factors among resting follicles

photo.scene: a rack of test tubes holding pale golden platelet-rich plasma next to a small lab centrifuge, a gloved hand placing one tube, clean bright lab, shallow depth of field
photo.alt: Tubes of platelet-rich plasma beside a centrifuge, prepared for PRP ovaries treatment

illustration.subject: side cross-section of the female pelvis during transvaginal egg retrieval
illustration.action: an ultrasound probe in the vagina guides a thin needle through the vaginal wall into the ovary, where it reaches a mature follicle holding an egg
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of egg retrieval: an ultrasound probe guides a fine needle to a follicle in the ovary

photo.scene: a calm recovery area with a reclining chair, a soft blanket and a cup of tea on a side table; a partner's hand holding the hand of a woman resting under the blanket, faces out of frame
photo.alt: A woman resting under a blanket after egg retrieval while her partner holds her hand

illustration.subject: frontal cross-section of the uterus with both tubes and ovaries
illustration.action: the uterine cavity and its lining clearly shown, with a small round inset magnifying an early embryo and its chromosomes
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of what recurrent miscarriage specialists check: uterine shape, lining and embryo chromosomes

photo.scene: a couple in their late 30s sitting close on a garden bench in soft afternoon light, holding hands, her head on his shoulder, calm and supportive
photo.alt: A couple holding hands on a garden bench, supporting each other after pregnancy loss

illustration.subject: two greatly enlarged human sperm heads side by side in cut-away view
illustration.action: the left one with neatly packed, intact DNA strands, the right one with several broken DNA strands
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of what a sperm DNA fragmentation test finds: intact vs broken DNA in the sperm head

photo.scene: a man in his mid-30s cooking a healthy dinner with fresh vegetables in a bright home kitchen, relaxed, evening light
photo.alt: A man in his 30s cooking a healthy dinner at home

illustration.subject: a day-5 human blastocyst greatly enlarged
illustration.action: with a round magnified inset of one of its cells showing the nucleus and its chromosomes
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of a euploid embryo: a blastocyst whose cells carry the normal number of chromosomes

photo.scene: a couple in their late 30s walking hand in hand along a seaside boardwalk at sunset, seen from behind, relaxed
photo.alt: A couple walking hand in hand by the sea at sunset

illustration.subject: two side-by-side paths that lead to the same uterus
illustration.action: on the left an egg from the woman's own ovary, on the right an egg from a younger donor's ovary; each becomes an embryo, and both arrows end in the same uterus shown in frontal cross-section
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration comparing egg donor IVF and IVF with your own eggs: either embryo goes into your uterus

photo.scene: a woman in her early 40s sitting at a cafe table writing in a notebook, a cup of coffee beside her, thoughtful and calm, window light
photo.alt: A woman in her 40s weighing egg donor IVF against IVF with her own eggs

illustration.subject: a close-up of one growing ovarian follicle in cross-section
illustration.action: the egg surrounded by cumulus cells, the fluid-filled cavity, the inner granulosa cell layer and the outer theca layer with tiny blood vessels
illustration.alt: Labelled illustration of a growing follicle and its egg, where diminished ovarian reserve treatment aims to help

photo.scene: a small pill organizer with supplement capsules and a glass of water on a kitchen counter in morning light, a woman's hand reaching for it
photo.alt: Morning supplements on a kitchen counter, part of some diminished ovarian reserve treatment plans
